scope: LibreCAD_3 entity lineweight export and explicit loss reporting
finding: The adapter cast an unsupported custom entity width to an invalid enum; the current codec rejected the entire export. Valid explicit and ByBlock entity widths were omitted by R12/R14 without an entity loss report.
change: For unrepresentable custom widths or explicit/ByBlock widths in versions without entity lineweight, retain the by-layer fallback and report a deduplicated entity-lineweight loss. Preserve representable explicit and ByBlock widths for modern output; leave implicit ByLayer alone.

verification.red: The focused custom-width export failed at ENTITIES on installed ABI-3 before the fix.
verification.green: PASS on macOS ARM64 for both the ABI-3 installed shared codec and pinned 2.0.0 static codec: 3 focused tests, including the existing layer controls. The entity control crosses custom, representable explicit, ByBlock and ByLayer widths with R12/R14/R2000 ASCII and binary, checks loss reporting and geometry readback, verifies modern explicit/ByBlock readback, bool-save behavior, and corrected custom-width retry to the same output.

limits: The follow-up is local and unmerged; apply the prior ordered consumer patches and layer-width follow-up first, then use git apply --unidiff-zero. Absent legacy width provenance, save UI behavior, other platforms and full application packaging remain open. Scratch drawings were generated by the tests and not committed; no independent 3D semantic evidence or phase gate is promoted.
